# Assessment Facts Overview

Supplementary documentation generated for the `eShopLegacyNTier` assessment. Each link below points to a document present in this report directory.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level architecture and component relationships for the WinForms client, WCF service, and LocalDB.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) — Declared external NuGet dependencies, compatibility concerns, and test dependencies.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) — WCF service catalog, operations, communication behavior, DTOs, and call sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — EF6 database configuration, entity relationships, ownership, and data classification.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, settings, secrets, and framework versions.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Catalog and stock workflows, domain mapping, and business rules.
